name: LocalParty prototype library
purpose: Approved-first index of reusable art, effects, UI and game systems for fast LocalParty alpha prototypes.

defaultPolicy.alphaFirst: When a user has not supplied purpose-built resources, search this catalog before generating or downloading art.
defaultPolicy.mobile: Host-only heavy art must never be imported by a phone controller entry point. Prefer an atlas already used by that controller or CSS/canvas primitives for controls.

project-generated.label: Project-generated
project-generated.usage: Reusable inside this project. Keep the source/provenance record with the asset; do not claim an external stock license.

project-code.label: Local project code
project-code.usage: Reuse inside this repository; preserve behavior tests when extracting.

collections.title: Tintable toy actors
collections.pivot: from shared2d manifest; centered unless overridden
collections.tint: semantic tint mask for every member
collections.animation: single pose; animate transform or use a rig collection
collections.mobileBundle: allowed only when explicitly preloaded by a controller; prefer one sprite, not the full atlas

collections.title: Reusable gameplay props
collections.pivot: from shared2d manifest; punchbag uses top suspension pivot
collections.tint: knife, ball, ship and wheel have tint masks
collections.animation: single pose; bomb fuse and projectile motion are runtime systems
avoidFor: mixing with strict frontal or strict top-down sprites without a visual gate
collections.mobileBundle: small individual sprites are allowed; do not preload unused props

collections.title: World tiles and accents
collections.animation: single pose; sparkle may be pulsed or rotated with reduced-motion fallback
avoidFor: seamless wall unless a repeat/seam check passes
dense decoration inside the play path
collections.mobileBundle: host preferred; individual small accents are allowed

collections.title: Articulated 2D rigs
collections.camera: fixed side/front three-quarter cutout; never substitute for strict top-down turrets
collections.pivot: explicit per-part pivots and rig anchors in shared2d manifest
collections.tint: all listed parts have tint masks
collections.animation: runtime articulated transforms; preserve manifest rig and muzzle anchors
collections.mobileBundle: host-only by default because several source sprites are large

collections.title: Top-down swarm enemies
collections.camera: strict 90 degree top-down, orthographic, no visible horizon or side elevation
collections.pivot: manifest pivot; ground contact/center must stay stable across motion and death
collections.animation: single live pose; pair with a class-specific death sheet before production

collections.title: Top-down turrets, bases and ammunition
collections.camera: all gameplay pieces must read from the same strict top-down orthographic camera
collections.pivot: barrels rotate around base center; muzzle/end pivot must match projectile spawn; pedestal centered under base
collections.tint: player color belongs in a separate marker/bubble unless a tested mask exists
collections.animation: rotate head in screen plane; short recoil; spawn projectile at muzzle; trail follows projectile and fades after impact
avoidFor: any side-view or three-quarter tower image
pedestals whose camera does not match the head

collections.title: Seamable defensive wall and gate
collections.camera: fixed host camera: straight south/front face with consistent top cap
collections.animation: swap gate/damage states; repair/damage overlays must share the same alignment

collections.title: Projectiles, muzzle flashes and impact marks
collections.camera: screen-plane effects; rotate only around screen normal
collections.pivot: center for impacts; muzzle at weapon emission point
collections.tint: use dedicated variants; do not hue-shift highlights blindly
collections.animation: projectile remains visible through travel; trail is attached, then contracts and fades; impact uses short scale/opacity curve
avoidFor: mixing old line effect behind the projectile
collections.mobileBundle: host-only; controller feedback should use CSS vibration/color

collections.title: Top-down explosion sheet
collections.animation: 8 frames in numeric order; clamp random scale and rotation so silhouette remains readable
avoidFor: random scale/rotation outside an authored narrow range

collections.title: Frontal gallery targets and obstacles
collections.pivot: targets centered; covers aligned to a shared baseline
collections.animation: appear from behind cover, hit reaction, then a readable death; keep friendly state unmistakable

collections.title: Frontal target death sheet
collections.animation: 8 frames in numeric order; show target disappearance clearly before removing the entity

collections.title: Existing alpha backdrops and scene illustrations
collections.camera: use only with a scene whose camera matches the selected file
collections.animation: static; optional low-amplitude parallax on separate layers only
avoidFor: assuming menu art is gameplay art

collections.title: Rubik UI font
avoidFor: unbounded condensed all-caps text at tiny sizes
collections.mobileBundle: approved; preload only weights actually used

systems.title: Manifest-driven atlas drawing and tint masks
systems.mobileBundle: allowed when the selected game already uses it; preload only selected keys

systems.title: Small DOM art accents
systems.mobileBundle: optional; do not include for a controller without visible art accents

systems.title: Responsive lobby, HUD and safe-area shell
systems.mobileBundle: approved; verify each game at 320-430px and landscape

systems.title: Simple clean arena reference
systems.mobileBundle: controller logic stays separate in games/party/public/controller.js

systems.title: Projectile, attached trail and impact lifecycle
